verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from T-Mobile Arena and The Shops at Crystals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a spectacular oasis steps from T-Mobile Arena and The Shops at Crystals.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits at CityCenter in the center of the Strip and is connected by sky bridge to The Shops at Crystals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Center Strip at CityCenter, connected by sky bridge to The Shops at Crystals

verified_facts.text: Aria, Cosmopolitan and T-Mobile Arena are an easy walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: an easy walk to Aria, Cosmopolitan, and T-Mobile Arena

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 2009 as Mandarin Oriental Las Vegas and became Waldorf Astoria Las Vegas in 2018.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel opened in 2009 as Mandarin Oriental Las Vegas and became Waldorf Astoria Las Vegas in 2018

verified_facts.text: The hotel is non-gaming and non-smoking.
verified_facts.excerpt: retaining its non-gaming, non-smoking identity even as the branding changed

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, city or Strip views and deep soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room and suite features floor-to-ceiling windows, breathtaking city or Strip views, deep soaking tubs, and premium amenities.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature a walk-in wardrobe and a private valet closet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in modern spaces featuring chic décor, a walk-in wardrobe, and a private valet closet.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are done in a desert-inspired palette of soft neutrals, warm woods and jewel-tone accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: redesigned in a desert-inspired palette of soft neutrals, warm woods, and jewel-tone accents

verified_facts.text: Soaking tubs are positioned so the skyline becomes part of the bathroom design.
verified_facts.excerpt: deep soaking tubs positioned to make the skyline part of the bathroom design

verified_facts.text: Peacock Alley serves Afternoon Tea, custom-crafted cocktails and bites with views of the Strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the timeless tradition of Afternoon Tea, discover custom-crafted cocktails, and savor delectable bites alongside captivating views of the Strip.

verified_facts.text: Peacock Alley is on the 23rd floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The biggest food-and-drink update is the 23rd floor, where Peacock Alley now serves the brand’s signature tea service in a glamorous setting

verified_facts.text: Hard Shake's cocktails are inspired by the hard shake method.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a craft inspired by the revered hard shake method, blending precision, technique, and imagination.

verified_facts.text: Zen Kitchen serves seasonal American classics.
verified_facts.excerpt: where vibrant, seasonal American classics take center stage

verified_facts.text: The pool deck is on the eighth floor and has panoramic views of the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a refreshing swim on our eighth-floor pool deck and enjoy panoramic views of the city.

verified_facts.text: The pool deck has cabanas and loungers and no DJ.
verified_facts.excerpt: no blaring DJ set, no aggressive bottle parade, just a compact, elegant deck with cabanas and loungers

verified_facts.text: The spa spans two levels above the Strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into an award-winning spa perched high above the vibrant Las Vegas Strip. Spanning two serene levels

verified_facts.text: The spa has a Vitality Pool with hydrotherapy jets and mineral currents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Let soothing hydrotherapy jets, gentle mineral currents, and tranquil warmth prepare you for a state of pure relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The spa's couples experience includes a body exfoliation, an aromatherapy massage and a private hydrotherapy bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a refreshing body exfoliation, a customized aromatherapy massage, and a private hydrotherapy bath.

verified_facts.text: Fitness classes are complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: state-of-the-art training, and scenic, complimentary fitness classes

verified_facts.text: There is a full gym and a yoga studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a full gym and yoga studio plus classes included through the resort fee

verified_facts.text: Service includes personal concierges and twice-daily housekeeping.
